source_categories_note: Vocabulary only. The trade/customs/standard/nomenclature categories were ratified in earlier sprints; 'corporate_financial_report' and 'corporate_sustainability_report' were added in Pilot 02 (issuer-primary corporate disclosures) so an issuer's own audited statements are not mislabeled as market/industry press. identity_revision_note: identity_revision is a governed, immutable revision id for a source's bibliographic identity. A source-use qualification records qualified_against_source_revision; if identity_revision changes, that qualification becomes review-required. Added incrementally (only where a qualification depends on it) without touching status/lock.
